ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק נִשְׁאַר בָּאָרֶץ גַּם כְּשֶׁהָיָה קָשֶׁה לִמְצֹא אֹכֶל.
ideas.children_en: Isaac was a shepherd during a famine. God told him to stay in the land and promised to bless him, increase his children, and give them the land because Abraham, his father, obeyed God's commands.

ideas.children_he: הַפַּחַד גָּרַם לְיִצְחָק לְהַסְתִּיר אֶת הָאֱמֶת.
ideas.children_en: Isaac lived in Gerar and said Rebecca was his sister to protect her. Abimelech saw she was his wife and told people not to hurt them.

ideas.children_he: הַצְלָחָה שֶׁל אָדָם אֶחָד עֲלוּלָה לְעוֹרֵר קִנְאָה בַּאֲחֵרִים.
ideas.children_en: Isaac was blessed and had a huge harvest, becoming rich. The Philistines were jealous; they closed his father's wells. Abimelech told Isaac to leave because he was too powerful.

ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק בָּחַר לְהִתְרַחֵק מִמְּרִיבוֹת וּלְחַפֵּשׂ מַיִם בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר.
ideas.children_en: Isaac moved and dug wells for water. The Philistines fought him over these wells, so he gave them names after the fights. Then he dug a good well called Rehoboth, meaning a place to live peacefully.

ideas.children_he: גַּם בְּמָקוֹם חָדָשׁ יִצְחָק שָׁמַר עַל אֱמוּנָתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Isaac went to Beersheba. God promised to bless him because of Abraham. Isaac built an altar and called on God's name publicly there.

ideas.children_he: גַּם מִי שֶׁרָב אִתְּךָ בֶּעָבָר יָכוֹל לִרְצוֹת שָׁלוֹם.
ideas.children_en: Abimelech and his officers came to Isaac for a treaty. They saw God was with Isaac and wanted peace and friendship because he is blessed.

ideas.children_he: אֲרוּחָה מְשֻׁתֶּפֶת יְכוֹלָה לְחַזֵּק קֶשֶׁר בֵּין אֲנָשִׁים.
ideas.children_en: Isaac agreed to the treaty and made a feast for them. This is the custom after making an agreement to celebrate together.

ideas.children_he: הַבְטָחָה לִשְׁמֹר עַל שָׁלוֹם עוֹזֶרֶת לִמְנֹעַ מְרִיבוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Next morning they made a vow to keep the treaty and be friends. Isaac sent them away safely, and they left peacefully.

ideas.children_he: מַיִם הֵם אוֹצָר חָשׁוּב, בִּמְיֻחָד בְּאֶרֶץ יְבֵשָׁה.
ideas.children_en: Isaac’s servants told him about a well they found. They dug more wells. Isaac called one well Shibah after the oath with Abimelech, so the city was named Beersheba.

ideas.children_he: הַבְּחִירוֹת שֶׁל הַיְּלָדִים לִפְעָמִים מַדְאִיגוֹת אֶת הַהוֹרִים.
ideas.children_en: Esau was forty years old and married two Hittite women. This caused grief to Isaac and Rebekah.
